ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.23.07 - the Registration text entities added in .06 now publish their new value immediately on set, instead of only on the 60s template poll. A client that wrote a field and read it straight back saw the OLD value for up to a minute and could not distinguish a slow publish from a write that never landed, which defeats the point of verifying the write. The stored value was always correct; only the reported state lagged.
